teaser.en: Small yellow star-shaped flowers mark this bush shrub, one of the most popular medicines among the Digo.
teaser.sw: Maua madogo ya manjano yenye umbo la nyota hukitambulisha kichaka hiki cha vichakani, mojawapo ya dawa maarufu zaidi miongoni mwa Wadigo.

summary.en: *Mkone* is a Grewia shrub of the coastal bushland, with toothed three-veined leaves and small yellow star flowers. It is one of the popular Digo medicines.
summary.sw: *Mkone* ni kichaka cha jenasi ya *Grewia* cha vichaka vya pwani, chenye majani yenye meno na mishipa mitatu, na maua madogo ya manjano kama nyota. Ni mojawapo ya dawa maarufu za Kidigo.

about.en: *Mkone* is a shrub or small tree. Its leaves are toothed along the edges and have three main veins running from the base, a Grewia trademark. The flowers are small yellow stars, and they are followed by small round fruits.
about.sw: *Mkone* ni kichaka au mti mdogo. Majani yake yana meno pembeni na mishipa mikuu mitatu inayoanzia kwenye kitako cha jani, alama ya kipekee ya *Grewia*. Maua yake ni madogo ya manjano kama nyota, na hufuatwa na matunda madogo ya mviringo.

uses.en: It is a popular Digo medicine. Grewia fruits are also widely eaten as snacks in East Africa.
uses.sw: Ni dawa maarufu ya Kidigo. Matunda ya *Grewia* pia huliwa sana kama vitafunio Afrika Mashariki.

names.en: The name *mkone* is shared across Digo, Duruma, Giriama and Swahili. No English common name has been recorded; botanists call it *Grewia plagiophylla*.
names.sw: Jina *mkone* linatumika kwa pamoja katika Kidigo, Kiduruma, Kigiriama na Kiswahili. Hakuna jina la kawaida la Kiingereza lililorekodiwa; wataalamu wa mimea wanauita *Grewia plagiophylla*.

reason.en: Another coastal bush shrub used as medicine
reason.sw: Kichaka kingine cha vichaka vya pwani kinachotumika kama dawa

reason.en: Another popular Digo medicine of the bush
reason.sw: Dawa nyingine maarufu ya Kidigo ya vichakani
